The First press includes an EG inner sleeve with album covers pictures, including the complete Obscure series.


Track B2 Bogota is actually Caracas. The credits are the same.

Also in existence is a rear cover with a gold 'Promotional Copy Not For Resale' stamp. Everything else is identical to this version.
